_comment: Provenance for this port. The private original was read, never modified; what is published is a rewrite, and copy_files records the bytes actually shipped.

source.location: private worker-bundles object store, bundle for domain-uptime-monitor v0.1.0

port.shape: one standard-library Python script, a SKILL.md, a README, an example config and tests
port.principle: Nothing the original hard-coded about one person, one company or one deployment survives. Anything the script needs and cannot infer is required config, and the script refuses rather than guessing.
port.verified_before_porting: run.py was read end to end and confirmed to do real work against real data. A seeded template in the same store (`job-digest`) was read as a negative control: its run.py returns an empty success and its SKILL.md instructs the model to write plausible illustrative content. It was not ported.

note: Rewritten from a private Floom pure-script worker of the same name, v0.1.0, retrieved from the private worker-bundles store on 2026-09-17. The original run.py was read end to end first, to confirm it performs real HTTPS probes and real content checks rather than reporting a fabricated status; it does. Nothing is copied byte for byte. The monitored host list, the alert recipient and sender, the per-domain content markers and the one hard-coded authenticated write-path probe are all config now. Two defects found during live verification of the port were fixed here and are covered by tests: a body with Content-Encoding: gzip was matched against the marker while still compressed, failing a healthy site, and two config entries for the same host silently overwrote each other in the report.
genericisations: the 26-host production domain list is gone; 'domains' is required config
notify_email and email_from have no default and the run refuses rather than inventing one
the single hard-coded authenticated write probe for one private app became a declarative per-domain post_check with fail_if/ok_status
state path is --state, default .uptime/state.json, was a fixed Floom context path
the critical-domain count is computed from config, not the constant 7
all references to the private deployment, its cron host and its owner removed

license.licensed_work: the complete domain-uptime-monitor bundle, including this derivation record
license.note: The LICENSE bytes are the upstream Apache-2.0 text unmodified except for the appendix copyright line, and match the other bundles in this repository byte for byte. No comparative evaluation of this Skill has been run and no quality state is asserted; the package tests it ships are tests, not evals.

hash_scope: copy_files lists every file this bundle ships except DERIVATION.json, because a record cannot contain its own hash. copy_files_sha256 is the sha256 of 'path:sha256' lines in path order, one per line, each terminated by a newline.
